# PUT /api/v1/teams/{id}/members/{username}

Add a team member

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-062`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — user is blocked by the organization
- **404** — team or user does not exist

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Mutating team operations require org ownership (reqOrgOwnership middleware) | authorization | User is not site admin AND not org owner |
| Adding team member also adds user to organization if not already a member | business_logic | User is not org member |
| Cannot add a user who is blocked by the organization | validation | user_model.IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, user, team.OrgID) returns true |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| user is blocked by org | 403 | forbidden | False |

### Error Paths

- **team not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **user not found** → GetContextUserByPathParam → 404
- **user blocked by org** → AddTeamMember → 403
